column3: BSB renders “overseership” as “to be an overseer” and “good work” as “noble task.”
BSB adds “but” to “the husband of one wife” and renders “sober” as “temperate.”
BSB follows the critical text without “not greedy for base gain,” which the Textus Receptus adds; “dependent on wine” renders “given to wine.”
BSB starts a new sentence with “An overseer must” and renders “having children in submission” as “keep his children under control.”
BSB adds “He must” and “the same … as,” interpreting “the judgment of the devil” as the devil’s own condemnation.
BSB renders “a good testimony from those outside” as “a good reputation with outsiders.”
BSB starts a new sentence with “They must.”
BSB adds “as deacons” and moves “if they are above reproach” forward.
BSB adds “but”; “the women” could also mean “wives.”
BSB renders the plural as singular (“A deacon must be”) and adds “but.”
BSB adds “as deacons” and renders “good standing” as “high standing.”
BSB reorders the verse with “Although I hope to come to you soon.”
BSB follows the critical text with “He” (ὃς); the Textus Receptus has “God.” “By common confession” renders “confessedly,” and “vindicated by the Spirit” renders “justified in the Spirit.”
